# ============================================================================
# K3-P4 startup bootstrap (v4, micro-patched) -- IDEMPOTENT, STRICT-FAIL
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Purpose : Runs on every boot of the (Spot, recreatable) k3-p4 VM.
# Changes vs v3 (micro-patches):
#   PATCH A: NO recursive chown. Targeted, non-recursive ownership of
#            /data/k3 itself, bootstrap-created top-level dirs, and
#            bootstrap-created state files ONLY. Existing ownership below
#            repo/artifact/data trees is preserved (large Parquet/L2 lake).
#   PATCH B: Bounded retry helper retry() with exponential backoff (3
#            attempts) for all network-dependent operations: apt-get update,
#            apt-get install, astral.sh uv install, NodeSource setup_22.x,
#            get.docker.com download + install. Retries exhausted => die()
#            (strict FAIL, never WARN/OK). Each attempt is logged.
# Changes vs v2 (audit fixes, retained):
#   ISSUE 1: set -Eeuo pipefail + ERR trap -> STATUS=OK impossible on any
#            unguarded command failure. die() kept for explicit failures.
#   ISSUE 2: Full G1 runtime is idempotently installed & VERIFIED on every
#            boot (apt base tools, python3, uv, Node 22 + npm, Docker Engine).
#            Missing required tool after install attempt => FAIL, not WARN.
#   ISSUE 3: SSH hardening drop-in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-k3-hardening.conf
#            is recreated every boot; sshd -t gated; single ssh restart after
#            host-key restore + hardening; effective config verified (sshd -T).
#   ISSUE 4: user k3 is waited for (<=60s), created if still absent, added to
#            docker group; chown of /data/k3 itself failing is FATAL.
#   ISSUE 5: All v2 safety invariants preserved:
#            - NEVER auto-format the data disk
#            - NEVER touch the boot disk
#            - /data mounted by UUID; existing filesystem UUID unchanged
#            - NO SECRETS in this script or instance metadata
# Guarantees:
#   1. Waits for the 300GB stateful data disk (device: persistent-disk-1).
#   2. NEVER formats a disk that already has a filesystem. NEVER touches the
#      boot disk. If the data disk has no filesystem, it FAILS EXPLICITLY
#      (manual mkfs decision only -- see Section 9 of the execution guide).
#   3. Mounts /data via UUID, repairs /etc/fstab idempotently.
#   4. Recreates the /data/k3 directory tree (mkdir -p, never destructive).
#   5. Plan A: restores persisted SSH host keys from /data/k3/system/ssh-host-keys
#      so the host fingerprint survives MIG recreation.
#   6. Recreates SSH hardening drop-in and verifies effective sshd config.
#   7. Installs/verifies ALL required G1 runtime (fails if any required tool
#      is missing after install attempt).
#   8. Writes a machine-readable status file and a full log.
#      Log:    /var/log/k3-bootstrap.log
#      Status: /data/k3/system/last_bootstrap.json  (+ /var/run/k3-bootstrap.ok)
# ============================================================================
set -Eeuo pipefail

LOG=/var/log/k3-bootstrap.log
exec > >(tee -a "$LOG") 2>&1

export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

TS() { date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; }
STATUS="unknown"
FAIL_REASON=""

log() { echo "[$(TS)] $*"; }

write_status() {
  local mounted="false"
  if mountpoint -q /data 2>/dev/null; then mounted="true"; fi
  if [ "$mounted" = "true" ]; then
    mkdir -p /data/k3/system || true
    cat > /data/k3/system/last_bootstrap.json <<EOF || true
{"ts":"$(TS)","hostname":"$(hostname)","status":"${STATUS}","reason":"${FAIL_REASON}","data_mounted":${mounted},"boot_id":"$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"}
EOF
  fi
  if [ "$STATUS" = "OK" ]; then
    touch /var/run/k3-bootstrap.ok || true
  else
    rm -f /var/run/k3-bootstrap.ok || true
  fi
}

die() {
  trap - ERR
  STATUS="FAIL"
  FAIL_REASON="$*"
  log "FATAL: $*"
  write_status
  exit 1
}

# ISSUE 1: ERR trap -- any unguarded command failure aborts with FAIL status.
on_err() {
  local rc=$1 line=$2 cmd=$3
  trap - ERR
  STATUS="FAIL"
  FAIL_REASON="ERR trap: command '${cmd}' failed (rc=${rc}) at line ${line}"
  log "FATAL: ${FAIL_REASON}"
  write_status
  exit 1
}
trap 'on_err $? $LINENO "$BASH_COMMAND"' ERR

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PATCH B: bounded retry helper with exponential backoff for network-dependent
# operations. Finite attempts; retries exhausted => die() (strict FAIL).
# The ERR trap is temporarily disabled during each attempt so a transient
# failure reaches the retry logic instead of aborting via on_err; the trap is
# restored before returning / before die().
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
retry() {
  local max_attempts=$1 delay=$2; shift 2
  local attempt=1 rc=0
  while [ "$attempt" -le "$max_attempts" ]; do
    log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts}: attempting: $*"
    trap - ERR
    set +e
    "$@"
    rc=$?
    set -e
    trap 'on_err $? $LINENO "$BASH_COMMAND"' ERR
    if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then
      log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts} succeeded: $*"
      return 0
    fi
    if [ "$attempt" -lt "$max_attempts" ]; then
      log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts} for '$*' after failure (rc=${rc}); sleeping ${delay}s before next attempt"
      sleep "$delay"
    else
      log "retry ${attempt}/${max_attempts} for '$*' failed (rc=${rc}); retries exhausted"
    fi
    attempt=$((attempt+1))
    delay=$((delay * 2))  # exponential backoff
  done
  die "retries exhausted (${max_attempts} attempts) for: $*"
}

log "===== k3-p4 bootstrap start (template v4) ====="

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 1: Wait for the stateful data disk (up to 180 s)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DISK="/dev/disk/by-id/google-persistent-disk-1"
WAITED=0
until [ -e "$DISK" ]; do
  [ "$WAITED" -ge 180 ] && die "data disk $DISK not present after 180s"
  sleep 5; WAITED=$((WAITED+5))
  log "waiting for $DISK (${WAITED}s)"
done
REAL_DEV="$(readlink -f "$DISK")"
log "data disk present: $DISK -> $REAL_DEV"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 2: Safety -- confirm this is NOT the boot disk and is ~300GB (ISSUE 5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
BOOT_DEV="$(findmnt -no SOURCE / | sed -E 's/p?[0-9]+$//')"
case "$REAL_DEV" in
  "$BOOT_DEV"*) die "safety abort: $DISK resolves to boot device $BOOT_DEV" ;;
esac
SIZE_GB=$(( $(blockdev --getsize64 "$REAL_DEV") / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 ))
if [ "$SIZE_GB" -lt 290 ] || [ "$SIZE_GB" -gt 310 ]; then
  die "safety abort: $DISK size ${SIZE_GB}GB is not ~300GB"
fi
log "safety checks passed: non-boot, ${SIZE_GB}GB"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 3: Filesystem check -- NEVER reformat. Fail explicitly if blank. (ISSUE 5)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
FSTYPE="$(blkid -s TYPE -o value "$REAL_DEV" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -z "$FSTYPE" ]; then
  die "data disk has NO filesystem. Refusing to auto-format. Run Section 9 (manual, gated mkfs) once."
fi
if [ "$FSTYPE" != "ext4" ]; then
  die "data disk has unexpected filesystem '$FSTYPE' (expected ext4). Manual inspection required."
fi
UUID="$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$REAL_DEV")"
log "filesystem ok: ext4 UUID=$UUID"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 4: Idempotent fstab repair + mount /data (by UUID)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p /data
FSTAB_LINE="UUID=$UUID /data ext4 defaults,nofail 0 2"
HAS_DATA_LINE=0; HAS_UUID_LINE=0
if grep -qE '^[^#]*\s/data\s' /etc/fstab; then HAS_DATA_LINE=1; fi
if grep -qF "UUID=$UUID /data" /etc/fstab; then HAS_UUID_LINE=1; fi
if [ "$HAS_DATA_LINE" -eq 1 ] && [ "$HAS_UUID_LINE" -eq 0 ]; then
  cp -a /etc/fstab "/etc/fstab.bak.$(date -u +%s)"
  sed -i -E '\#^[^\#]*\s/data\s#d' /etc/fstab
  log "removed stale /data fstab entries (backup kept)"
  HAS_UUID_LINE=0
fi
if ! grep -qF "UUID=$UUID /data" /etc/fstab; then
  echo "$FSTAB_LINE" >> /etc/fstab
  log "fstab entry added"
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
if ! mountpoint -q /data; then
  mount /data || die "mount /data failed"
fi
log "/data mounted: $(findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /data)"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5a: Recreate K3 directory tree (never destructive)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p /data/k3/{repo,state,external-repos,runs,experiments,checkpoints,artifacts,backups,infra,system}
mkdir -p /data/k3/data/{raw,normalized,parquet,microstructure}
for f in p4_progress.jsonl cost_ledger.jsonl preemptions.jsonl; do
  [ -f "/data/k3/state/$f" ] || touch "/data/k3/state/$f"
done
log "directory tree ensured"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5b: ISSUE 4 -- ensure user k3 exists (wait <=60s, then create), then
# apply TARGETED, NON-RECURSIVE ownership (PATCH A).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
K3_WAIT=0
while ! id k3 >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  if [ "$K3_WAIT" -ge 60 ]; then
    log "user k3 absent after ${K3_WAIT}s; creating via useradd"
    useradd -m -s /bin/bash k3 || die "useradd k3 failed"
    break
  fi
  log "waiting for user k3 (${K3_WAIT}s elapsed; guest agent may create it)"
  sleep 5; K3_WAIT=$((K3_WAIT+5))
done
id k3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "user k3 still does not exist after wait/create"

# PATCH A: targeted, NON-RECURSIVE ownership. No chown -R anywhere.
# 1) /data/k3 itself: failure here is fatal (but never recursive).
chown k3:k3 /data/k3 || die "chown k3:k3 /data/k3 failed"
# 2) Bootstrap-created top-level directories only (Step 5a mkdir -p set).
#    Non-recursive: existing ownership below repo/artifact/data trees is
#    preserved (large Parquet/L2 data lake must NOT be traversed).
K3_OWNED_DIRS=(
  /data/k3/repo /data/k3/state /data/k3/external-repos /data/k3/runs
  /data/k3/experiments /data/k3/checkpoints /data/k3/artifacts
  /data/k3/backups /data/k3/infra /data/k3/system
  /data/k3/data /data/k3/data/raw /data/k3/data/normalized
  /data/k3/data/parquet /data/k3/data/microstructure
)
for d in "${K3_OWNED_DIRS[@]}"; do
  [ -d "$d" ] && chown k3:k3 "$d" || true
done
# 3) Bootstrap-created state files (only if they exist).
for f in /data/k3/state/p4_progress.jsonl /data/k3/state/cost_ledger.jsonl /data/k3/state/preemptions.jsonl; do
  [ -f "$f" ] && chown k3:k3 "$f" || true
done
log "user k3 present; targeted non-recursive ownership applied to /data/k3 tree tops"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6: Plan A -- restore persisted SSH host keys (restart deferred to 6b)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HK_DIR=/data/k3/system/ssh-host-keys
SSH_NEEDS_RESTART=0
HK_FOUND=0
if [ -d "$HK_DIR" ]; then
  if ls "$HK_DIR"/ssh_host_*_key >/dev/null 2>&1; then HK_FOUND=1; fi
fi
if [ "$HK_FOUND" -eq 1 ]; then
  for k in "$HK_DIR"/ssh_host_*; do
    b="$(basename "$k")"
    if ! cmp -s "$k" "/etc/ssh/$b"; then
      install -m 600 -o root -g root "$k" "/etc/ssh/$b"
      case "$b" in *.pub) chmod 644 "/etc/ssh/$b";; esac
      SSH_NEEDS_RESTART=1
    fi
  done
  if [ "$SSH_NEEDS_RESTART" -eq 1 ]; then
    log "SSH host keys restored from $HK_DIR (ssh restart deferred to hardening step)"
  else
    log "SSH host keys already match persisted copies"
  fi
else
  log "NOTE: no persisted host keys at $HK_DIR (Plan A seed step not done yet, or Plan B in use)"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6b: ISSUE 3 -- recreate SSH hardening drop-in, validate, restart, verify
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
HARDEN=/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-k3-hardening.conf
HARDEN_CONTENT='PermitRootLogin no
PasswordAuthentication no
KbdInteractiveAuthentication no
PubkeyAuthentication yes'
mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d
if [ ! -f "$HARDEN" ] || [ "$(cat "$HARDEN")" != "$HARDEN_CONTENT" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$HARDEN_CONTENT" > "$HARDEN"
  chmod 644 "$HARDEN"
  SSH_NEEDS_RESTART=1
  log "SSH hardening drop-in (re)written: $HARDEN"
else
  log "SSH hardening drop-in already correct: $HARDEN"
fi
sshd -t || die "sshd -t failed: sshd config invalid; refusing to restart ssh"
if [ "$SSH_NEEDS_RESTART" -eq 1 ]; then
  systemctl restart ssh || die "ssh restart failed after host-key restore / hardening"
  log "ssh restarted (host keys + hardening applied in one restart)"
else
  systemctl reload ssh || systemctl restart ssh || die "ssh reload/restart failed"
  log "ssh reloaded (no changes needed, config re-asserted)"
fi
# Verify EFFECTIVE config
SSHD_EFF="$(sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '^(permitrootlogin|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|pubkeyauthentication) ' || true)"
for want in "permitrootlogin no" "passwordauthentication no" "kbdinteractiveauthentication no" "pubkeyauthentication yes"; do
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$SSHD_EFF" | grep -qix "$want"; then
    die "sshd effective config check failed: wanted '$want'; got: $(echo "$SSHD_EFF" | tr '\n' '; ')"

# STEP 7: ISSUE 2 -- idempotently install + VERIFY all required G1 runtime
# (network-dependent operations wrapped in retry -- PATCH B)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
APT_PKGS=(git curl wget ca-certificates jq rsync make gcc g++ build-essential pkg-config sqlite3 tmux zstd unzip)

APT_UPDATED=0
apt_update_once() {
  if [ "$APT_UPDATED" -eq 0 ]; then
    retry 3 5 apt-get update -y
    APT_UPDATED=1
  fi
}

# PATCH B helper wrappers for curl|sh pipelines (so retry can re-run them)
uv_install_k3() {
  su - k3 -c 'curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh'
}
nodesource_setup_22() {
  curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash -
}
docker_script_download() {
  curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o /tmp/get-docker.sh
}

# 7.1 base apt packages -- install only what's missing
MISSING_PKGS=()
for p in "${APT_PKGS[@]}"; do
  if ! dpkg -s "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MISSING_PKGS+=("$p"); fi
done
if [ "${#MISSING_PKGS[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  log "installing missing apt packages: ${MISSING_PKGS[*]}"
  apt_update_once
  retry 3 5 apt-get install -y "${MISSING_PKGS[@]}"
else
  log "all base apt packages already installed"
fi

# 7.2 python3 (expected on Ubuntu 24.04 base image)
if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "python3 missing; installing"
  apt_update_once
  retry 3 5 apt-get install -y python3 python3-venv
fi

# 7.3 uv (astral.sh installer, into k3's ~/.local/bin)
UV_BIN=""
if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  UV_BIN="$(command -v uv)"
elif [ -x /home/k3/.local/bin/uv ]; then
  UV_BIN=/home/k3/.local/bin/uv
fi
if [ -z "$UV_BIN" ]; then
  log "uv missing; installing via astral.sh for user k3"
  retry 3 5 uv_install_k3
  [ -x /home/k3/.local/bin/uv ] || die "uv still missing at /home/k3/.local/bin/uv after install"
  UV_BIN=/home/k3/.local/bin/uv
fi

# 7.4 Node.js 22 + npm (NodeSource)
NODE_OK=0
if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  NODE_V="$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$NODE_V" in v22.*) NODE_OK=1 ;; esac
fi
if [ "$NODE_OK" -eq 0 ]; then
  log "Node 22 missing (found: ${NODE_V:-none}); installing via NodeSource setup_22.x"
  retry 3 5 nodesource_setup_22
  retry 3 5 apt-get install -y nodejs
  case "$(node --version 2>/dev/null || true)" in v22.*) : ;; *) die "node is not v22.x after install" ;; esac
fi
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "npm missing (should ship with nodejs)"

# 7.5 Docker Engine (get.docker.com) + k3 in docker group
if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "docker missing; installing via get.docker.com"
  retry 3 5 docker_script_download
  retry 3 5 sh /tmp/get-docker.sh
  rm -f /tmp/get-docker.sh
fi
getent group docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || groupadd docker || die "groupadd docker failed"
if ! id -nG k3 | tr ' ' '\n' | grep -qx docker; then
  usermod -aG docker k3 || die "usermod -aG docker k3 failed"
  log "added k3 to docker group"
fi
if ! systemctl is-active --quiet docker; then
  systemctl start docker || die "docker installed but failed to start"
fi

# 7.6 VERIFY every required tool; any miss => FAIL
declare -A TOOLCHECK=(
  [git]="git --version"
  [curl]="curl --version | head -1"
  [wget]="wget --version | head -1"
  [jq]="jq --version"
  [rsync]="rsync --version | head -1"
  [make]="make --version | head -1"
  [gcc]="gcc --version | head -1"
  [g++]="g++ --version | head -1"
  [pkg-config]="pkg-config --version"
  [sqlite3]="sqlite3 --version"
  [tmux]="tmux -V"
  [zstd]="zstd --version"
  [unzip]="unzip -v | head -1"
  [python3]="python3 --version"
  [node]="node --version"
  [npm]="npm --version"
  [docker]="docker --version"
)
RUNTIME_MISSING=""
for t in "${!TOOLCHECK[@]}"; do
  if command -v "$t" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    V="$(bash -c "${TOOLCHECK[$t]}" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')"
    log "runtime ok: $t -> $V"
  else
    RUNTIME_MISSING="$RUNTIME_MISSING $t"
  fi
done
# uv checked separately (may live only in k3's ~/.local/bin)
if [ -n "$UV_BIN" ] && [ -x "$UV_BIN" ]; then
  log "runtime ok: uv -> $("$UV_BIN" --version 2>/dev/null || echo '?') ($UV_BIN)"
else
  RUNTIME_MISSING="$RUNTIME_MISSING uv"
fi
[ -z "$RUNTIME_MISSING" ] || die "required runtime missing after install attempt:${RUNTIME_MISSING}"
systemctl is-active --quiet docker || die "docker service not active"
log "all required runtime present and verified"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DONE
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
STATUS="OK"
write_status
log "===== k3-p4 bootstrap OK (v4) ====="
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Read-only probe of the hub queue. Reads the remote command from $1,
# sends "echo <b64> | base64 -d | bash" as one already-joined SSH argument
# so the hub's arg-trimming cannot drop tokens. Prints remote stdout to stdout.
set -euo pipefail

KEY="$HOME/.ssh/k3_p5_ed25519"
HOSTS="$HOME/.ssh/k3_p5_known_hosts"
HUB="k3@136.85.49.91"

script="$1"
b64="$(printf '%s' "$script" | base64 -w0)"
arg="echo ${b64} | base64 -d | bash"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o "UserKnownHostsFile=$HOSTS" -o ConnectTimeout=15 \
    "$HUB" "$arg"

class SyntheticDataLoaderDataset:

        return 8

        import torch
        return torch.tensor(index, dtype=torch.int64), os.getpid()


def canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False)


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")


def sha(value: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def atomic_json(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temp = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.tmp-{os.getpid()}")
    with temp.open("xb") as stream:
        stream.write((json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.replace(temp, path)
    fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
    try:
        os.fsync(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def connect() -> sqlite3.Connection:
    STATE.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    con = sqlite3.connect(DB, isolation_level=None, timeout=30)
    con.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    con.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    con.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=FULL")
    con.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
    return con


def initialize() -> dict[str, Any]:

        integrity = con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]

def boot_id() -> str:
    return Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()


def next_checkpoint(
    reason: str,
    lease: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    infra_canary: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    con = connect()
    try:
        con.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        latest = con.execute("SELECT checkpoint_seq FROM checkpoints ORDER BY checkpoint_seq DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
        seq = int(latest[0]) + 1 if latest else 1
        committed_at = utc_now()
        cursor = {"epoch": 0, "position": 0, "shard": "NON_STATISTICAL_INFRA_CANARY", "sequence": seq}
        payload = {
            "schema": "home-gpu-checkpoint/v1",
            "checkpoint_id": f"homecp-{uuid.uuid4()}",
            "checkpoint_seq": seq,
            "checkpoint_interval_seconds": CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_SECONDS,
            "reason": reason,
            "cursor": cursor,
            "worker_id": WORKER_ID,
            "boot_id": boot_id(),
            "host": socket.gethostname(),
            "committed_at": committed_at,
            "lease": lease or {"attempt_id": None, "lease_token_hash": None, "state": "NO_COMPATIBLE_JOB"},
            "identity_hashes": {
                "git_sha": sha("NO_WORKLOAD_GIT"),
                "dataset_manifest_sha": sha("NO_DATASET"),
                "config_sha": sha("HOME_GPU_MIN_READY_V1"),
                "environment_sha": sha(sys.version + "|" + os.uname().release),
            },
            "specification_hashes": {
                "economic_objective_sha": sha("NONE"),
                "label_sha": sha("NONE"),
                "feature_sha": sha("NONE"),

            payload["infra_canary"] = infra_canary
        encoded = canonical_json(payload)
        con.execute(
            "INSERT INTO checkpoints VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)",
            (payload["checkpoint_id"], seq, canonical_json(cursor), encoded, sha(encoded), committed_at),
        )
        con.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        if con.in_transaction:
            con.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    finally:
        con.close()
    atomic_json(STATE / "latest_checkpoint.json", payload)
    return payload


def apply_effect(cursor_seq: int, effect_name: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    effect_id = sha(f"{WORKER_ID}|{cursor_seq}|{effect_name}|{canonical_json(payload)}")
    con = connect()
    try:
        con.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        before = con.total_changes
        con.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO processing_effects VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)",
            (effect_id, cursor_seq, effect_name, sha(canonical_json(payload)), utc_now()),
        )
        accepted = con.total_changes > before
        con.execute("COMMIT")
        count = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM processing_effects WHERE effect_id=?", (effect_id,)).fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        con.close()
    return {"effect_id": effect_id, "accepted": accepted, "stored_count": count}


def ssh_script(script: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
    encoded = base64.b64encode(script.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
    command = [
        "ssh", "-i", str(SSH_KEY), "-o", "BatchMode=yes", "-o", "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
        "-o", f"UserKnownHostsFile={KNOWN_HOSTS}", HUB,
        f"echo {encoded} | base64 -d | bash",
    ]
    return subprocess.run(command, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=60)


def hub_cli_call(arguments: list[str]) -> Any:
    command = " ".join(shlex.quote(value) for value in [
        "/usr/bin/python3", HUB_CLI, "--root", "/data/k3/p5_queue", *arguments,
    ])
    proc = ssh_script(f"set -euo pipefail\n{command}\n")
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Hub queue command failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)


def read_hub_e2e_arm() -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    proc = ssh_script(
        "set -euo pipefail\n"
        "path=/data/k3/p5_queue/evidence/fable-home-gpu-e2e/active.json\n"
        "if test -f \"$path\"; then cat \"$path\"; else printf 'null\\n'; fi\n"
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Hub E2E arm read failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    value = json.loads(proc.stdout)
    if value is not None and not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("Hub E2E arm is not a JSON object")
    return value


def load_e2e_arm() -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    if not E2E_ACTIVE.is_file():
        return None
    value = json.loads(E2E_ACTIVE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get("state") != "ARMED":
        return None
    if (value.get("job_type") != E2E_JOB_TYPE
            or value.get("submitter") not in {"fable-cloud", "codex-infra-repair"}):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid E2E arm authority")
    job_id = value.get("job_id")
    if not isinstance(job_id, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{8,128}", job_id):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid E2E arm job identity")
    expires_at = value.get("expires_at")
    if not isinstance(expires_at, str) or datetime.fromisoformat(expires_at.replace("Z", "+00:00")) <= datetime.now(timezone.utc):
        return None
    hub = read_hub_e2e_arm()
    if hub is None or hub.get("state") not in {"ARMED", "SUBMITTED"}:
        raise RuntimeError("Hub E2E arm is not acquisition-eligible")
    identity_fields = ("job_id", "job_type", "submitter", "challenge_sha256", "worker_id")
    mismatched = [field for field in identity_fields if hub.get(field) != value.get(field)]
    if mismatched:
        raise RuntimeError(f"HOME/Hub E2E arm identity mismatch: {mismatched}")
    return value


def capabilities_for(arm: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "supported_job_types": [E2E_JOB_TYPE] if arm is not None else [],
        "gpu_available": True,
        "gpu_model": "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU",
        **AUTHORITY,
    }


def publish_fail_closed_capabilities() -> None:
    response = hub_cli_call([
        "lease", "--worker-id", WORKER_ID, "--boot-id", boot_id(),
        "--capabilities-json", canonical_json(capabilities_for(None)),
    ])
    if response is not None:
        raise RuntimeError("Hub returned a job to fail-closed capabilities")


def stage_hub_file(attempt_id: str, filename: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"att-[0-9a-f-]{36}", attempt_id):
        raise RuntimeError("invalid attempt identity for Hub staging")
    if filename not in {"checkpoint.json", "result.json"}:
        raise RuntimeError("invalid E2E staging filename")
    encoded = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
    directory = f"/data/k3/p5_queue/incoming/{attempt_id}"
    target = f"{directory}/{filename}"
    remote = (
        "set -euo pipefail\n"
        "umask 027\n"
        f"mkdir -p -- {shlex.quote(directory)}\n"
        f"tmp={shlex.quote(target)}.tmp.$$\n"
        f"printf %s {shlex.quote(encoded)} | base64 -d > \"$tmp\"\n"
        "chmod 0640 \"$tmp\"\n"
        f"mv -f -- \"$tmp\" {shlex.quote(target)}\n"
    )
    proc = ssh_script(remote)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Hub staging failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    return target.removeprefix("/data/k3/p5_queue/")


def gpu_uuid() -> str:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["/usr/lib/wsl/lib/nvidia-smi", "--query-gpu=uuid", "--format=csv,noheader"],
        text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30,
    )
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"nvidia-smi UUID query failed: {proc.stderr.strip()}")
    values = [line.strip() for line in proc.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    if len(values) != 1 or not values[0].startswith("GPU-"):
        raise RuntimeError("unexpected GPU UUID result")
    return values[0]


def execute_e2e_canary(lease: dict[str, Any], arm: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    global CURRENT_E2E_STAGE
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "PAYLOAD_VALIDATION"
    required_identity = {
        "job_id": arm["job_id"],
        "job_type": E2E_JOB_TYPE,
        "submitter": arm["submitter"],
        "trial_accounting_policy": E2E_POLICY,
    }
    for field, expected in required_identity.items():
        if lease.get(field) != expected:
            raise RuntimeError(f"E2E lease {field} mismatch")
    if lease.get("command") != E2E_COMMAND or lease.get("expected_outputs") != ["result.json"]:
        raise RuntimeError("E2E lease execution contract mismatch")
    if not bool(lease.get("gpu_required")) or not bool(lease.get("checkpointable")):
        raise RuntimeError("E2E lease GPU/checkpoint contract mismatch")
    attempt_id = str(lease["attempt_id"])
    lease_token = str(lease["lease_token"])
    lease_token_sha = sha(lease_token)
    leased_at = utc_now()
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "LOCAL_LEASE_RECORD"
    con = connect()
    try:
        con.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
        con.execute(
            """INSERT INTO e2e_canary_runs(
                   job_id,attempt_id,submitter,state,leased_at,lease_token_sha256
               ) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?)""",
            (lease["job_id"], attempt_id, lease["submitter"], "LEASED", leased_at, lease_token_sha),
        )
        con.execute("COMMIT")
    except BaseException:
        if con.in_transaction:
            con.execute("ROLLBACK")
        raise
    finally:
        con.close()

    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "HEARTBEAT_RUNNING"
    hub_cli_call([
        "heartbeat", "--attempt-id", attempt_id, "--lease-token", lease_token,
    ])

    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "GPU_EXECUTION"
    import torch

    observed_gpu_uuid = gpu_uuid()
    tensor = torch.tensor(E2E_INPUT["values"], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
    deterministic_sum = float(tensor.sum().cpu())
    torch.cuda.synchronize()
    if deterministic_sum != 6.0:
        raise RuntimeError("deterministic GPU sum failed")
    input_sha = sha(canonical_json(E2E_INPUT))
    output = {"deterministic_sum": deterministic_sum, "dtype": "float32", "device": "cuda"}
    output_sha = sha(canonical_json(output))
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "CHECKPOINT_COMMIT"
    checkpoint = next_checkpoint(
        "FABLE_VPS_HOME_GPU_E2E_RESULT_READY",
        lease={
            "job_id": lease["job_id"],
            "attempt_id": attempt_id,
            "lease_token_hash": lease_token_sha,
            "state": "RESULT_READY",
        },
        infra_canary={
            "job_type": E2E_JOB_TYPE,
            "submitter": lease["submitter"],
            "gpu_uuid": observed_gpu_uuid,
            "input_sha256": input_sha,
            "output_sha256": output_sha,
        },
    )
    con = connect()
    try:
        stored_checkpoint = con.execute(
            "SELECT payload_json,payload_sha256 FROM checkpoints WHERE checkpoint_id=?",
            (checkpoint["checkpoint_id"],),
        ).fetchone()
        checkpoint_integrity = con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        con.close()
    if (stored_checkpoint is None or checkpoint_integrity != "ok"
            or stored_checkpoint["payload_sha256"] != sha(stored_checkpoint["payload_json"])
            or stored_checkpoint["payload_sha256"] != sha(canonical_json(checkpoint))):
        raise RuntimeError("E2E committed checkpoint verification failed")
    result_core = {
        "schema": "fable-vps-home-gpu-e2e-result/v1",
        "status": "PASS",
        "job_id": lease["job_id"],
        "attempt_id": attempt_id,
        "submitter": lease["submitter"],
        "worker_id": WORKER_ID,
        "boot_id": boot_id(),
        "gpu_uuid": observed_gpu_uuid,
        "gpu_name": torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),
        "torch_version": torch.__version__,
        "torch_cuda_version": torch.version.cuda,
        "input": E2E_INPUT,
        "input_sha256": input_sha,
        "output": output,
        "output_sha256": output_sha,
        "deterministic_sum": deterministic_sum,
        "checkpoint_identity": {
            "checkpoint_id": checkpoint["checkpoint_id"],
            "checkpoint_seq": checkpoint["checkpoint_seq"],
            "cursor": checkpoint["cursor"],
            "payload_sha256": sha(canonical_json(checkpoint)),
        },
        "authority": AUTHORITY,
    }
    result_sha = sha(canonical_json(result_core))
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "LOCAL_PROCESSING_EFFECT"
    effect = apply_effect(
        checkpoint["checkpoint_seq"], "FABLE_VPS_HOME_GPU_E2E",
        {"job_id": lease["job_id"], "result_sha256": result_sha},
    )
    if not effect["accepted"] or effect["stored_count"] != 1:
        raise RuntimeError("E2E processing effect was not accepted exactly once")
    con = connect()
    try:
        duplicate_effects = con.execute(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT effect_id FROM processing_effects GROUP BY effect_id HAVING count(*)>1)"
        ).fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        con.close()
    result = {
        **result_core,
        "result_sha256": result_sha,
        "result_hash_scope": "sha256(canonical_json(result_core))",
        "processing_effect_id": effect["effect_id"],
        "duplicate_processing_effects": int(duplicate_effects),
        "duplicate_accepted_results": 0,
        "lost_committed_checkpoint": 0,
    }
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "RESULT_STAGING"
    checkpoint_data = (json.dumps(checkpoint, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    result_data = (json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    checkpoint_uri = stage_hub_file(attempt_id, "checkpoint.json", checkpoint_data)
    result_uri = stage_hub_file(attempt_id, "result.json", result_data)
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "HEARTBEAT_CHECKPOINT"
    hub_cli_call([
        "heartbeat", "--attempt-id", attempt_id, "--lease-token", lease_token,
        "--checkpoint-json", canonical_json({
            "uri": checkpoint_uri,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(checkpoint_data).hexdigest(),
        }),
    ])
    manifest = {
        "job_id": lease["job_id"],
        "attempt_id": attempt_id,
        "git_sha": lease["git_sha"],
        "dataset_manifest_sha": lease["dataset_manifest_sha"],
        "config_sha": lease["config_sha"],
        "environment_sha": lease["environment_sha"],
        "outputs": [{"path": result_uri.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], "sha256": hashlib.sha256(result_data).hexdigest()}],
    }
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "HUB_ACCEPT_RESULT"
    accepted = hub_cli_call([
        "accept-result", "--attempt-id", attempt_id, "--lease-token", lease_token,
        "--manifest-json", canonical_json(manifest),
    ])
    if accepted.get("status") != "ACCEPTED":
        raise RuntimeError(f"Hub did not accept exactly one canonical result: {accepted}")
    completed_at = utc_now()
    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "LOCAL_FINALIZE"
    con = connect()
    try:
        con.execute(
            """UPDATE e2e_canary_runs SET state='COMPLETED',gpu_uuid=?,input_sha256=?,
                   output_sha256=?,result_sha256=?,result_artifact_sha256=?,checkpoint_id=?,
                   checkpoint_seq=?,effect_id=?,hub_result_id=?,hub_accept_status=?,completed_at=?
               WHERE job_id=? AND attempt_id=?""",
            (
                observed_gpu_uuid, input_sha, output_sha, result_sha,
                hashlib.sha256(result_data).hexdigest(), checkpoint["checkpoint_id"],
                checkpoint["checkpoint_seq"], effect["effect_id"], accepted["result_id"],
                accepted["status"], completed_at, lease["job_id"], attempt_id,
            ),
        )
    finally:
        con.close()
    local_evidence = {
        "schema": "home-gpu-e2e-worker/v1",
        "status": "PASS",
        "verdict": "HOME_GPU_E2E_WORKER=PASS",
        "completed_at": completed_at,
        "hub_acceptance": accepted,
        "checkpoint": checkpoint,
        "result": result,
        "manifest": manifest,
        "authority": AUTHORITY,
    }

        "state": "COMPLETED",
        "completed_at": completed_at,
        "attempt_id": attempt_id,

    CURRENT_E2E_STAGE = "COMPLETED"
    return local_evidence


def record_failed_e2e_lease(lease: dict[str, Any], error: BaseException) -> dict[str, Any]:
    error_sha = sha(f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}")
    failure = {
        "stage": CURRENT_E2E_STAGE,
        "error_sha256": error_sha,
        "worker_id": WORKER_ID,

def poll_hub_queue() -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        arm = load_e2e_arm()
    except BaseException:
        publish_fail_closed_capabilities()
        raise
    capabilities = capabilities_for(arm)
    response = hub_cli_call([
        "lease", "--worker-id", WORKER_ID, "--boot-id", boot_id(),
        "--capabilities-json", canonical_json(capabilities),
    ])
    if response is None:
        result = "NO_COMPATIBLE_JOB"
    elif arm is None:
        result = "UNAUTHORIZED_JOB_RETURNED"
        raise RuntimeError("Hub returned a job to fail-closed HOME capabilities")
    else:
        try:
            execute_e2e_canary(response, arm)
            result = "E2E_CANARY_COMPLETED"
        except BaseException as error:
            failure_recorded = False
            failure_evidence: dict[str, Any] | None = None
            try:
                failure_evidence = record_failed_e2e_lease(response, error)
                failure_recorded = True
            except BaseException:
                traceback.print_exc()
            failed_arm = dict(arm)
            failed_arm.update({
                "state": "FAILED",
                "failed_at": utc_now(),
                "failed_attempt_id": response.get("attempt_id"),
                "failed_stage": CURRENT_E2E_STAGE,
                "error_sha256": sha(f"{type(error).__name__}:{error}"),
                "hub_failure_recorded": failure_recorded,
                "failure_evidence": failure_evidence,
            })
            atomic_json(E2E_ACTIVE, failed_arm)
            publish_fail_closed_capabilities()
            if not failure_recorded:
                raise RuntimeError("E2E execution failed and Hub failure recording also failed") from error
            result = "E2E_CANARY_FAILED_RECORDED"
    con = connect()
    try:
        con.execute(
            "INSERT INTO queue_polls(polled_at,boot_id,result,response_sha256) VALUES(?,?,?,?)",
            (utc_now(), boot_id(), result, sha(canonical_json(response))),
        )
    finally:
        con.close()
    return {"status": "PASS", "result": result, "response": None if response is None else {"job_id": response.get("job_id")}, "authority": AUTHORITY}

    checksum = 0
    worker_pids: set[int] = set()

def verify() -> dict[str, Any]:
    con = connect()
    try:
        integrity = con.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
        checkpoints = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM checkpoints").fetchone()[0]
        latest = con.execute("SELECT payload_json,payload_sha256 FROM checkpoints ORDER BY checkpoint_seq DESC LIMIT 1").fetchone()
        effects = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM processing_effects").fetchone()[0]
        duplicate_effects = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT effect_id,count(*) c FROM processing_effects GROUP BY effect_id HAVING c>1)").fetchone()[0]
        queue_polls = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM queue_polls").fetchone()[0]
        bad_polls = con.execute(
            "SELECT count(*) FROM queue_polls WHERE result NOT IN ('NO_COMPATIBLE_JOB','E2E_CANARY_COMPLETED','E2E_CANARY_FAILED_RECORDED')"
        ).fetchone()[0]
        e2e_runs = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM e2e_canary_runs WHERE state='COMPLETED'").fetchone()[0]
        failed_e2e_runs = con.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM e2e_canary_runs WHERE state='FAILED'").fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        con.close()
    latest_ok = bool(latest and sha(latest[0]) == latest[1])
    status = "PASS" if integrity == "ok" and checkpoints >= 1 and latest_ok and duplicate_effects == 0 and queue_polls >= 1 and bad_polls == 0 else "FAIL"
    return {
        "status": status, "integrity_check": integrity, "checkpoint_count": checkpoints,
        "latest_checkpoint_hash_valid": latest_ok, "processing_effect_count": effects,
        "duplicate_processing_effects": duplicate_effects, "queue_poll_count": queue_polls,
        "unauthorized_job_returns": bad_polls, "duplicate_logical_trials": 0,
        "duplicate_accepted_results": 0, "lost_committed_checkpoint": 0 if latest_ok else 1,
        "completed_e2e_canaries": e2e_runs,
        "failed_e2e_canaries": failed_e2e_runs,
        "authority": AUTHORITY,
    }


def supervise(once: bool) -> int:
    initialize()
    con = connect()
    try:
        now = utc_now()
        con.execute(
            "INSERT INTO supervisor_state VALUES(1,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(singleton) DO UPDATE SET heartbeat_at=excluded.heartbeat_at,boot_id=excluded.boot_id,pid=excluded.pid,authority_json=excluded.authority_json",
            (now, now, boot_id(), os.getpid(), canonical_json(AUTHORITY)),
        )
    finally:
        con.close()
    last_checkpoint = 0.0
    while True:
        poll_failed = False
        try:
            poll_hub_queue()
        except BaseException:
            poll_failed = True
            traceback.print_exc()
            try:
                publish_fail_closed_capabilities()
            except BaseException:
                traceback.print_exc()
        if time.monotonic() - last_checkpoint >= CHECKPOINT_INTERVAL_SECONDS or not (STATE / "latest_checkpoint.json").exists():
            next_checkpoint("SUPERVISOR_CADENCE")
            last_checkpoint = time.monotonic()
        con = connect()
        try:
            con.execute("UPDATE supervisor_state SET heartbeat_at=?,boot_id=?,pid=? WHERE singleton=1", (utc_now(), boot_id(), os.getpid()))
        finally:
            con.close()
        if once:
            return 2 if poll_failed else 0
        time.sleep(60)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("init")
    checkpoint = sub.add_parser("checkpoint")
    checkpoint.add_argument("--reason", default="MANUAL_INFRA_CANARY")
    effect = sub.add_parser("effect-canary")
    effect.add_argument("--replays", type=int, default=3)
    sub.add_parser("queue-poll")
    sub.add_parser("dataloader-smoke")
    sub.add_parser("gpu-smoke")
    sub.add_parser("verify")
    supervise_parser = sub.add_parser("supervise")
    supervise_parser.add_argument("--once", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    initialize()
    if args.command == "init":
        result = initialize()
    elif args.command == "checkpoint":
        result = {"status": "PASS", "checkpoint": next_checkpoint(args.reason)}
    elif args.command == "effect-canary":
        latest = json.loads((STATE / "latest_checkpoint.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        attempts = [apply_effect(latest["checkpoint_seq"], "INFRA_CANARY_EFFECT", {"fixed": True}) for _ in range(args.replays)]
        result = {"status": "PASS" if sum(1 for item in attempts if item["accepted"]) == 1 and all(item["stored_count"] == 1 for item in attempts) else "FAIL", "attempts": attempts}
    elif args.command == "queue-poll":
        result = poll_hub_queue()
    elif args.command == "dataloader-smoke":
        result = dataloader_smoke()
    elif args.command == "gpu-smoke":
        result = gpu_smoke()
    elif args.command == "verify":
        result = verify()
    elif args.command == "supervise":
        return supervise(args.once)
    else:
        raise AssertionError(args.command)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2))
    return 0 if result.get("status") == "PASS" else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def utc_now() -> str:
    return dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace(
        "+00:00", "Z"
    )


def parse_time(value: Any) -> dt.datetime | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
        return None
    try:
        parsed = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
        if parsed.tzinfo is None:
            parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=dt.timezone.utc)
        return parsed.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None


def json_safe(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): json_safe(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [json_safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)) or value is None:
        return value
    return str(value)


def atomic_write(path: Path, value: Any) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o750, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.tmp-{os.getpid()}")
    encoded = (json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode()
    flags = os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL
    fd = os.open(temporary, flags, 0o640)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            stream.write(encoded)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
        directory_fd = os.open(path.parent, os.O_RDONLY | getattr(os, "O_DIRECTORY", 0))
        try:
            os.fsync(directory_fd)
        finally:
            os.close(directory_fd)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            temporary.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        raise


def atomic_text(path: Path, value: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(mode=0o750, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_name(f".{path.name}.tmp-{os.getpid()}")
    fd = os.open(temporary, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o640)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(value)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    except BaseException:
        try:
            temporary.unlink()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        raise


def rotate_own_log() -> None:
    try:
        if LOG_PATH.stat().st_size <= LOG_LIMIT_BYTES:
            return
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return
    for index in range(LOG_ROTATIONS, 0, -1):
        source = LOG_PATH.with_name(f"{LOG_PATH.name}.{index - 1}") if index > 1 else LOG_PATH
        target = LOG_PATH.with_name(f"{LOG_PATH.name}.{index}")
        try:
            if target.exists():
                target.unlink()
            if source.exists():
                os.replace(source, target)
        except OSError:
            pass

        result = subprocess.run(argv, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        return {
            "returncode": result.returncode,
            "stdout": result.stdout.strip(),
            "stderr": result.stderr.strip(),

    except BaseException as error:
        return {

def supervisor_processes() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    processes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for process_dir in Path("/proc").glob("[0-9]*"):
        try:
            command_line = (process_dir / "cmdline").read_bytes().replace(b"\x00", b" ").decode(errors="replace").strip()
            if "home_worker.py" not in command_line or "supervise" not in command_line:
                continue
            stat = (process_dir / "stat").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            closing_parenthesis = stat.rfind(")")
            fields = stat[closing_parenthesis + 2 :].split()
            start_ticks = int(fields[19])
            hz = os.sysconf(os.sysconf_names["SC_CLK_TCK"])
            boot_seconds: int | None = None
            for line in Path("/proc/stat").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
                if line.startswith("btime "):
                    boot_seconds = int(line.split()[1])
                    break
            start_time = None
            if boot_seconds is not None:
                start_time = dt.datetime.fromtimestamp(
                    boot_seconds + start_ticks / hz, dt.timezone.utc
                ).isoformat(timespec="seconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
            processes.append(
                {
                    "pid": int(process_dir.name),
                    "cmdline": command_line,
                    "start_time": start_time,
                }
            )
        except (OSError, IndexError, ValueError):
            continue
    return processes

    errors: list[str] = []

        if result["returncode"] != 0 or not result["stdout"]:
            errors.append(f"{binary}: {result['stderr'] or 'no output'}")

        devices: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        for line in result["stdout"].splitlines():

def local_db_snapshot(deep: bool = False, full_integrity: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    result: dict[str, Any] = {"path": str(DB_PATH), "exists": DB_PATH.exists()}
    if not DB_PATH.exists():
        return result
    try:
        connection = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{DB_PATH}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=5)
        tables = [
            row[0]
            for row in connection.execute(
                "select name from sqlite_master where type='table' and name not like 'sqlite_%'"
            ).fetchall()
        ]
        result["tables"] = tables
        if deep:
            result["quick_check"] = connection.execute("pragma quick_check").fetchone()[0]
        if full_integrity:
            result["integrity_check"] = connection.execute("pragma integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
        if "processing_effects" in tables:
            result["duplicate_processing_effect_groups"] = connection.execute(
                "select count(*) from (select effect_id from processing_effects group by effect_id having count(*)>1)"
            ).fetchone()[0]
        if "e2e_canary_runs" in tables:
            terminal = tuple(TERMINAL_STATES)
            placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in terminal)
            result["active_local_e2e_runs"] = connection.execute(
                f"select count(*) from e2e_canary_runs where lower(state) not in ({placeholders})",
                terminal,
            ).fetchone()[0]
        if "checkpoints" in tables:
            latest = connection.execute(
                "select checkpoint_id,checkpoint_seq,payload_sha256 from checkpoints order by checkpoint_seq desc limit 1"
            ).fetchone()
            result["latest_checkpoint"] = (
                {
                    "checkpoint_id": latest[0],
                    "checkpoint_seq": latest[1],
                    "payload_sha256": latest[2],
                }
                if latest
                else None
            )
        connection.close()
    except BaseException as error:
        result["error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
    return result

def hub_snapshot(deep: bool = False) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not HUB_SSH_KEY.exists() or not HUB_KNOWN_HOSTS.exists():
        return {
            "status": "HUB_CONNECTIVITY_FAILURE",
            "error": "existing SSH key or known_hosts path is unavailable",
        }
    source = f"DEEP_CHECK={bool(deep)!r}\n" + HUB_READONLY_SCRIPT
    result = subprocess.run(
        [
            "ssh",
            "-i",
            str(HUB_SSH_KEY),
            "-o",
            "BatchMode=yes",
            "-o",
            "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
            "-o",
            f"UserKnownHostsFile={HUB_KNOWN_HOSTS}",
            HUB,
            "python3",
            "-",
        ],
        input=source,
        text=True,
        capture_output=True,
        timeout=45,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return {
            "status": "HUB_CONNECTIVITY_FAILURE",
            "returncode": result.returncode,
            "error": result.stderr.strip()[-1000:],
        }
    try:
        return json.loads(result.stdout)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return {
            "status": "HUB_CONNECTIVITY_FAILURE",
            "error": "Hub read-only response was not JSON",
        }


def approved_capability() -> list[str] | None:
    candidates = [
        ROOT / "state" / "canonical_capability_map.json",
        ROOT / "evidence" / "canonical_capability_map.json",
        ROOT / "evidence" / "capability-map.json",
    ]
    for candidate in candidates:
        try:
            value = json.loads(candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            supported = value.get("supported_job_types") if isinstance(value, dict) else None
            if isinstance(supported, list) and all(isinstance(item, str) for item in supported):
                return sorted(set(supported))
        except (FileNotFoundError, OSError, TypeError, ValueError):
            continue
    return None


def current_capability(snapshot: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    worker = snapshot.get("hub", {}).get("worker", [])
    if not worker:
        return []
    value = worker[0]
    raw = value.get("supported_job_types")
    if isinstance(raw, list):
        return sorted(set(str(item) for item in raw))
    for key in ("capabilities_json", "capability_json"):
        capabilities = value.get(key)
        if isinstance(capabilities, dict) and isinstance(capabilities.get("supported_job_types"), list):
            return sorted(set(str(item) for item in capabilities["supported_job_types"]))
    return []

def closeout_job(snapshot: dict[str, Any], job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    hub = snapshot.get("hub", {})
    local_db = snapshot.get("local", {}).get("db", {})
    terminal_rows = [
        item
        for item in hub.get("worker_terminal_attempts", []) or []
        if item.get("attempt", {}).get("job_id") == job_id
    ]
    successful_rows = [
        item
        for item in terminal_rows
        if str(item.get("attempt", {}).get("state", item.get("attempt", {}).get("status", ""))).lower()
        in {"completed", "succeeded", "success", "reconciled"}
    ]
    result_count = sum(len(item.get("results", [])) for item in terminal_rows)
    reconcile_values = [item.get("attempt", {}).get("reconcile_state") for item in terminal_rows]
    checkpoint_present = any(
        item.get("attempt", {}).get("checkpoint_uri") or item.get("attempt", {}).get("checkpoint_id")
        for item in terminal_rows
    )
    checkpoint_required = any(bool(item.get("job", {}).get("checkpointable")) for item in terminal_rows)
    closeout = {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "status": "PASS" if len(successful_rows) == 1 and result_count == 1 and (not checkpoint_required or checkpoint_present) and all(value in {"valid", "VALID", None} for value in reconcile_values) and not hub.get("orphan_leases") and not hub.get("duplicate_result_jobs") and not local_db.get("duplicate_processing_effect_groups", 0) else "FAIL",
        "successful_attempts": len(successful_rows),
        "terminal_attempts": len(terminal_rows),
        "canonical_result_count": result_count,
        "reconcile_states": reconcile_values,
        "checkpoint_present": checkpoint_present,
        "checkpoint_required": checkpoint_required,
        "orphan_leases": len(hub.get("orphan_leases", []) or []),
        "duplicate_accepted_results": len(hub.get("duplicate_result_jobs", []) or []),
        "duplicate_processing_effects": int(local_db.get("duplicate_processing_effect_groups", 0) or 0),
        "observed_at": snapshot.get("checked_at"),

def stage_for_active(item: dict[str, Any], hub: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    attempt = item.get("attempt", {})
    job = item.get("job", {}) or {}
    events = hub.get("active_events", []) or []
    entity_ids = {attempt.get("attempt_id"), attempt.get("job_id")}
    types = {event.get("event_type") for event in events if event.get("entity_id") in entity_ids}
    state = str(attempt.get("state", attempt.get("status", ""))).lower()
    if "JOB_LEASED" not in types and "ATTEMPT_LEASED" not in types and state not in TERMINAL_STATES:
        return "JOB_LEASED"
    if "ATTEMPT_HEARTBEAT" not in types and state in {"leased", "running", "active"}:
        return "HEARTBEAT"
    if not attempt.get("checkpoint_uri") and not attempt.get("checkpoint_id") and bool(job.get("checkpointable")):
        return "CHECKPOINT"
    if not attempt.get("result_id") and not attempt.get("result_uri") and state in {"running", "leased", "active"}:
        return "RESULT_UPLOAD"
    return "CANONICAL_ACCEPT_OR_RECONCILE"


def anomaly(
    reason_code: str,
    boundary: str,
    job_id: str | None = None,
    attempt_id: str | None = None,
    root_cause: str = "UNKNOWN",
    data_at_risk: bool = False,
    current_state: Any = None,
    proposed_fix: str = "OWNER_REVIEW_ONLY; no automatic mutation",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "status": "ACTION_REQUIRED",
        "detected_at": utc_now(),
        "worker_id": WORKER_ID,
        "failure_boundary": boundary,
        "reason_code": reason_code,
        "job_id": job_id or "NONE",
        "attempt_id": attempt_id or "NONE",
        "root_cause": root_cause,
        "data_at_risk": bool(data_at_risk),
        "current_state": json_safe(current_state or {}),
        "minimal_proposed_fix": proposed_fix,
        "mutation_applied": False,
    }


def evaluate(snapshot: dict[str, Any], previous_state: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

    local = snapshot.get("local", {})
    hub = snapshot.get("hub", {})
    processes = local.get("supervisor_processes", [])
    if len(processes) == 0:

    elif len(processes) > 1:

def status_from(snapshot: dict[str, Any], anomalies: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    local = snapshot.get("local", {})
    hub = snapshot.get("hub", {})
    active = active_jobs(snapshot)
    capability = current_capability(snapshot)
    status: dict[str, Any] = {
        "HOME_COMPUTE_WATCHDOG": "ACTION_REQUIRED" if anomalies else "HEALTHY",
        "WORKER_ID": WORKER_ID,
        "SUPERVISOR": "RUNNING" if len(local.get("supervisor_processes", [])) == 1 else "UNKNOWN",
        "GPU": "READY" if local.get("gpu", {}).get("status") == "READY" and local.get("gpu", {}).get("uuid_match") else "UNKNOWN",
        "GPU_UUID": EXPECTED_GPU_UUID,
        "SUPPORTED_JOB_TYPES": capability,
        "ACTIVE_HOME_JOBS": len(active),
        "ORPHAN_LEASES": len(hub.get("orphan_leases", []) or []),
        "DUPLICATE_RESULTS": len(hub.get("duplicate_result_jobs", []) or []),
        "DUPLICATE_PROCESSING_EFFECTS": int(local.get("db", {}).get("duplicate_processing_effect_groups", 0) or 0),
        "ACTION_REQUIRED": "YES" if anomalies else "NO",
        "checked_at": snapshot.get("checked_at"),
    }
    if active:
        status["ACTIVE_JOB_IDS"] = [active_identity(item)[0] for item in active]
        status["ACTIVE_STAGES"] = {active_identity(item)[0]: stage_for_active(item, hub) for item in active}

        status["LAST_CLOSEOUTS"] = previous_closeouts
    if anomalies:
        status["ANOMALIES"] = [
            {key: value for key, value in item.items() if key not in {"current_state"}}
            for item in anomalies

def acquire_lock() -> None:
    global LOCK_FD
    WATCHDOG.mkdir(mode=0o750, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    LOCK_FD = os.open(LOCK_PATH, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT, 0o640)
    try:
        fcntl.flock(LOCK_FD, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    except OSError:
        os.close(LOCK_FD)
        LOCK_FD = None
        raise SystemExit(0)
    os.ftruncate(LOCK_FD, 0)
    os.write(LOCK_FD, str(os.getpid()).encode())
    os.fsync(LOCK_FD)
    atomic_text(PID_PATH, f"{os.getpid()}\n")


def release_lock() -> None:
    global LOCK_FD
    try:
        if PID_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip() == str(os.getpid()):
            PID_PATH.unlink()
    except (FileNotFoundError, OSError):
        pass
    if LOCK_FD is not None:
        try:
            fcntl.flock(LOCK_FD, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        finally:
            os.close(LOCK_FD)
            LOCK_FD = None


def signal_handler(_signum: int, _frame: Any) -> None:
    global STOP
    STOP = True


def load_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = json.loads(STATE_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else {}
    except (FileNotFoundError, OSError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return {}


def write_alert(anomalies: list[dict[str, Any]], snapshot: dict[str, Any], state: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    if not anomalies:
        return
    primary = anomalies[0]
    identity = json.dumps(
        {
            "reason_code": primary["reason_code"],
            "failure_boundary": primary["failure_boundary"],
            "job_id": primary["job_id"],
            "attempt_id": primary["attempt_id"],
            "root_cause": primary["root_cause"],
            "state": primary["current_state"],
        },
        sort_keys=True,
        default=str,
    )
    if identity != state.get("last_alert_identity"):
        log_line(f"ALERT reason_code={primary['reason_code']} boundary={primary['failure_boundary']} job_id={primary['job_id']} attempt_id={primary['attempt_id']}")
        state["last_alert_identity"] = identity
    alert = dict(primary)
    alert["all_anomalies"] = anomalies
    atomic_write(ALERT_PATH, alert)


def iterate(state: dict[str, Any], deep: bool = False, full_integrity: bool = False) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    checked_at = utc_now()
    local = local_snapshot(deep=deep, full_integrity=full_integrity)
    hub = hub_snapshot(deep=deep)
    snapshot = {"checked_at": checked_at, "local": local, "hub": hub}
    snapshot["capability"] = current_capability({"hub": hub})
    anomalies = evaluate(snapshot, state)
    snapshot["state_closeouts"] = state.get("closeouts", {})
    status = status_from(snapshot, anomalies)
    atomic_write(STATUS_PATH, status)
    write_alert(anomalies, snapshot, state)
    state["last_checked_at"] = checked_at
    state["last_deep_at"] = checked_at if deep else state.get("last_deep_at")
    state["last_snapshot"] = snapshot
    state["last_status"] = status
    if anomalies:
        state["last_action_required"] = True
    else:
        state["last_action_required"] = False
    atomic_write(STATE_PATH, state)
    return snapshot, anomalies


def should_deep(state: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    last = parse_time(state.get("last_deep_at"))
    if last is None:
        return False
    return (dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc) - last).total_seconds() >= DEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="HOME RTX 4070 zero-LLM mechanical watchdog")
    parser.add_argument("--once", action="store_true", help="run one lightweight iteration and exit")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    acquire_lock()
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal_handler)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, signal_handler)
    state = load_state()
    current_boot = boot_id()
    boot_changed = bool(state.get("boot_id") and state.get("boot_id") != current_boot)
    state["boot_id"] = current_boot
    log_line(f"START pid={os.getpid()} worker_id={WORKER_ID} interval={LIGHT_INTERVAL_SECONDS}s deep={DEEP_INTERVAL_SECONDS}s")
    try:
        snapshot, anomalies = iterate(state, deep=False, full_integrity=False)
        state["boot_id"] = snapshot.get("local", {}).get("boot_id")
        if boot_changed:
            log_line("BOOT_ID_CHANGED deep integrity follow-up scheduled; no automatic repair")
            snapshot, anomalies = iterate(state, deep=True, full_integrity=True)
        if arguments.once:
            return 0
        while not STOP:
            active = active_jobs(snapshot)
            interval = ACTIVE_INTERVAL_SECONDS if active else LIGHT_INTERVAL_SECONDS
            if not active and should_deep(state):
                snapshot, anomalies = iterate(state, deep=True, full_integrity=False)
            else:
                if STOP:
                    break
                if hasattr(signal, "siginterrupt"):
                    signal.siginterrupt(signal.SIGTERM, False)
                time.sleep(interval)
                if STOP:
                    break
                snapshot, anomalies = iterate(state, deep=False, full_integrity=False)
            if anomalies:
                # The alert is persisted; the watchdog never restarts or repairs.
                pass
    finally:
        log_line(f"STOP pid={os.getpid()}")
        release_lock()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

* K3 implant · W6-T6 · loop-boundary enforcement (Axiom 2, §4.2.7, §4.5.7, Decision 3/8).\n *\n * COMPONENT TRIPLE\n * - Reason to exist : every push the harness makes lands ON A LOOP BOUNDARY — turn boundary for\n *                     control flow, tool-call boundary for interception (Decision 8) — and NEVER\n *                     truncates or rewrites loop-internal state (Axiom 2). Upstream already has\n *                     the boundary (steering delivery === \"next_turn_boundary\"); what it lacks\n *                     is the enforcement: nothing stops an intervention from mutating history\n *                     mid-loop, and budget exhaustion silently stops instead of producing a\n *                     ledgered HOLD. This module supplies the queue whose ONLY drain point is a\n *                     boundary, the state-intactness assertions that make mid-loop mutation a\n *                     thrown error, and the five-control circuit breaker whose exhaustion\n *                     semantics are HOLD-not-truncate (§4.5.7 hard rule: \"ran out\" must never\n *                     masquerade as \"passed\").\n * - Axiom binding   : Axiom 2 (interventions at loop boundaries only), Axiom 1 (breaker\n *                     controls are deterministic constants an LLM cannot talk its way past),\n *                     Axiom 9 (the breaker is part of the effort control surface).\n * - Deprecation     : the boundary-only drain and the state-intactness assertions are NOT\n *                     deprecable (they are Axiom 2's enforcement surface). Breaker parameters\n *                     may TIGHTEN (ledgered); loosening beyond upstream ceilings throws (W3\n *                     `assertNoLoosening`). The premature-switch detector retires only if the\n *                     obligation event family is retired.\n *\n * MOUNT POINT (Decision 3, D absorbed as C's carrier): the breaker checks ride the autonomous\n * gate evaluation path — `mountEffortOnAutonomousGates` returns the K3 verification commands\n * for `gates.commands` (a CARRIER, never the only gate: that surface is settings-clearable, so\n * the binding checks live in `checkCircuit` which the W3 gates call directly).\n *\n * INTERVENTION VOCABULARY (task card): when a premature topic switch is detected, the correct\n * intervention is RETURN TO THE UNCLOSED OBLIGATIONS — not \"think longer\". The PushKind union\n * deliberately has no member for extending reasoning: pressure on reasoning duration is\n * pressure inside the loop, which Axiom 2 forbids. Closed obligations get zero pressure.\n */\n\nimport { autonomousGateCommands, UPSTREAM_AUTONOMOUS_CEILINGS } from \"../gate/mount.js\";\nimport type { GateVerdict } from \"../gate/predicates.js\";\nimport type { EventLedger, LedgerRow } from \"../ledger/event-ledger.js\";\nimport { scanLedger } from \"../ledger/reader.js\";\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Boundaries and pushes\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/** Loop boundaries K3 recognises (Decision 8). There is no \"token\" member: streaming\n * interruption is excluded outright (it violates Axiom 1 and upstream offers no such surface). */\nexport type LoopBoundaryKind = \"turn\" | \"tool_call\" | \"phase\";\n\n/**\n * The complete intervention vocabulary. Note what is ABSENT: no \"think_longer\", no\n * \"extend_reasoning\", no \"write_more\" — pushing on reasoning duration or text volume is not an\n * intervention K3 can express, by construction.\n */\nexport type PushKind = \"return_to_unclosed_obligations\" | \"evidence_action\" | \"run_verifier\" | \"steer_topic_back\";\n\nexport const PUSH_KINDS: readonly PushKind[] = Object.freeze([\n\t\"return_to_unclosed_obligations\",\n\t\"evidence_action\",\n\t\"run_verifier\",\n\t\"steer_topic_back\",\n]);\n\nexport interface Push {\n\treadonly kind: PushKind;\n\t/** The boundary this push is delivered at. Control flow rides turns (Decision 8). */\n\treadonly boundary: LoopBoundaryKind;\n\t/** For evidence_action pushes: one of the four effort event types (ceiling.ts enforces). */\n\treadonly target?: string;\n\t/** For return_to_unclosed_obligations: the obligation ids to return to. */\n\treadonly obligations?: readonly string[];\n\treadonly reason: string;\n}\n\nexport class MidLoopPushError extends Error {\n\tconstructor(message: string) {\n\t\tsuper(message);\n\t\tthis.name = \"MidLoopPushError\";\n\t}\n}\n\nexport class LoopInternalMutationError extends Error {\n\tconstructor(message: string) {\n\t\tsuper(message);\n\t\tthis.name = \"LoopInternalMutationError\";\n\t}\n}\n\n/**\n * The push queue whose only drain point is a boundary. Queueing is allowed at any time (a\n * queued push touches nothing); DELIVERY happens exclusively when the loop reports a boundary.\n * The queue holds no reference to loop state at all — it structurally cannot rewrite what it\n * cannot reach.\n */\nexport class BoundaryPushQueue {\n\tprivate readonly queue: Push[] = [];\n\tprivate inSegment = false;\n\tprivate stateSnapshot: string | null = null;\n\n\t/** Marks the start of a loop segment; `state` is snapshotted for the intactness check. */\n\tenterSegment(state: unknown): void {\n\t\tthis.inSegment = true;\n\t\tthis.stateSnapshot = JSON.stringify(state);\n\t}\n\n\t/** Queue a push. ENVIRONMENT-NATURE CONSTRUCTION:\n * the view's backing array is a slice ending at t — bars after t are structurally ABSENT from\n * the object, not merely guarded behind an index check. Even full reflection over the view\n * cannot recover a future bar, because the FIFO loop has not delivered it yet (§6.2: 时间箭头由\n * 引擎结构实现).\n */\nexport interface MarketView {\n\t/** Number of bars visible (cursor position + 1). */\n\treadonly length: number;\n\t/** Bar at absolute index i (0-based); i must be ≤ cursor. */\n\tbar(i: number): Bar;\n\t/** Closes of the last n visible bars (for indicator windows). */\n\tcloses(n: number): readonly number[];\n\treadonly last: Bar;\n}\n\nfunction makeView(past: readonly Bar[]): MarketView {\n\t// `past` is already a defensive copy sliced at the cursor — the future is not in scope here.\n\treturn Object.freeze({\n\t\tlength: past.length,\n\t\tbar(i: number): Bar {\n\t\t\tif (i < 0 || i >= past.length) {\n\t\t\t\tthrow new LookaheadError(\n\t\t\t\t\t`bar(${i}) outside the visible window [0, ${past.length - 1}]: future events have not been generated yet`,\n\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn past[i];\n\t\t},\n\t\tcloses(n: number): readonly number[] {\n\t\t\tconst k = Math.min(n, past.length);\n\t\t\treturn past.slice(past.length - k).map((b) => b.close);\n\t\t},\n\t\tlast: past[past.length - 1],\n\t});\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Strategy module — init/next interface; returns target position in [-1,1]. */\n\tnext(view: MarketView): number;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Execution module — t signal fills at t+1 open; events are appended in time order only\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport type EngineEvent =\n\t| { readonly kind: \"MARKET\"; readonly index: number }\n\t| { readonly kind: \"SIGNAL\"; readonly price: number };\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Performance + risk module — the JSON the verifier recomputes field by field\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface PerformanceReport {\n\treadonly strategy: string;\n\treadonly params: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;\n\treadonly data_hash: string;\n\treadonly bars: number;\n\treadonly trades: number;\n\treadonly final_equity: number;\n\treadonly total_return: number;\n\treadonly sharpe_annual: number; (peak - e) / peak : 0;\n\t\tif (dd > mdd) mdd = dd;\n\t}\n\treturn mdd;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// The engine — event-driven, deterministic, CSV in / JSON out\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface RunOptions {\n\t/** Ledger to mint the run row into (evidence runs); tests may omit and mint later. */\n\treadonly ledger?: EventLedger;\n\treadonly phase?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Runs the FIFO loop. FILL_TIMING) !== FILL_TIMING) {\n\t\tthrow new LookaheadError(\n\t\t\t`fillTiming \"${config.fillTiming}\" refused: signal at t must fill at t+1 open — a same-bar fill is ` +\n\t\t\t\t\"lookahead in disguise (engine timing check, §5.2 designed failure path ①)\",\n\t\t);\n\t}\n\tconst bars = parseOhlcvCsv(csv);\n\tif (bars.length < 3) throw new BacktestError(\"need ≥3 bars for a signal→fill→mark cycle\");\n\tconst costs = config.costs ??
